seen.extent: Four letters, MNL OL X 10889: DF295070 (Pecsvarad, 16 Sep 1491, to Ludovico Sforza), DF295073 (Pecsvarad, 18 Nov 1491, to Maffeo da Treviglio), DF295143 (Buda, 8 Apr 1492, to Gian Galeazzo and Ludovico Sforza), DF295273 (Pecsvarad, 4 Jul 1492, to Ludovico Sforza); each original is 'eredeti' from ASMi Carteggio Sforzesco, Carteggio estero, Ungheria, 645; leaf counts not stated.
seen.cipher: MNL records (verbatim, Hungarian): all four originals carry 'Language of the material: olasz, titkosiras' (Italian, cipher); the Tartalom incipits/explicits are DF295143 'ELEJE: Le vostre Excellentie farano deciferare more solito...', DF295073 'ELEJE: [...] et li Dominij se governano..., VEGE: ... clarius intelligeris a presentii latore', DF295273 'ELEJE: Ho receputo le lettere..., VEGE: ... retenereme la copia', DF295070 'VEGE: ... hec ioco recreationis casu'. Decipherments are on record: DF295073 'Related material: FELOLD.: ASMi ... Carteggio Sforzesco, PE, Ungheria (1491-1530), 1491, Novembre, No. 7/2, Vestigia 2021' (that is DF295073-a, 'egyszeru masolat'); DF295143 'FELOLD. (reszlegesen): ... PE, Ungheria (1491-1530), 1492, Aprile, No. 6/a' (companion DF295143-a, Vestigia 2092); DF295273 'FELOLD.: ... 1492, Luglio, No. 6/a' (companion DF295273-a, 'forditas' = translation, Vestigia 2223). DF295070 shows no FELOLD. line; its copy note points only to MTA Milanese copies nos. 73-74.
